title: specy-road human decisions and routing preferences ledger

node.description: Roadmap node the entry belongs to; required for decision and human-action, optional for preference and standing-rule

kind.description: decision and human-action ask a person something about a leaf; preference records a routing rule the human stated for this project's sessions; standing-rule records an operator rule under which the coordinator may accept a leaf with limits (review operator-decision --rule), with the operator's words in why_now; it is never an open question nor applied as routing

decided_by.description: A closed decision written by review operator-decision: operator (the operator's own words) or coordinator (under a standing rule). The review gate reads only such a decision for the blocks and shortfall its answer names

channel.description: Closed decision and human-action entries only: where the decision was made. pm-gui: the PM recorded it from the PM GUI's status modal, and a coordinator processes it (grind-session --status lists it under decisions.gui_pending, unless the entry has criterion: finish-this-task consumes that one). terminal: a person confirmed it at an interactive terminal with decisions close, which records it only for an entry with criterion

criterion.description: human-action only: the node's human: acceptance criterion (A1, A2, ...) this entry asks a person to decide. finish-this-task counts the criterion decided only when such an entry is closed with decided_by operator and channel terminal or pm-gui, committed on the leaf branch or the integration branch; a planning-sheet A#: line does not count

summary.description: The question, or for a preference the routing rule in plain words

role.description: Preference only: the role the rule routes

models.description: Preference only: preferred roster ids, most preferred first. Whether a model is available or paused is not a preference: it is read from the roster (available, paused_until)

applies_to.description: Preference only: the leaf kinds the rule covers, in plain words (for example docs, data); omit for every leaf

expires.description: Preference and standing-rule only: active through this calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive) or until this datetime (ISO 8601); omit for no expiry

asked.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the question was opened

needed_by.description: Optional ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) by which a human answer is needed

closed.description: ISO 8601 date or datetime when the entry was closed
